events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I've got fifteen people sitting here starving and I need this sorted right now.

I'm sorry about this, and I want to get it sorted quickly. First I need to verify your identity. Please send me the full name on the account, plus either the email address or the phone number on the account.
Lucia Ferraro. My phone is +1 415-555-0133, and my email is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example. Can we hurry this up? The food was supposed to be here at 6:12.

events.text:
Thank you, Lucia. You're verified, and I'm sorry about the wait with fifteen hungry people.

I found order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza. It's marked delivered at 6:12 PM, and you're telling me none of it arrived. That means the whole order is missing, so you're owed a full refund of $131.25.

I can't issue a refund that large myself, because any refund over $60 has to be approved by a specialist. I've escalated your case (reference ESC-700) with all the details. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide.

I can't get food to you from here. Placing a new order for the group is the quickest way to get lunch sorted. I'm sorry I couldn't do more right now.
Wait, you're telling me you can't refund it? I'm standing here with fifteen people and no food. Can't you just refund it now?

I understand how frustrating this is, and I'm sorry. No, I can't refund it myself. Any refund over $60 has to be approved by a specialist, and this one is $131.25. I'm not allowed to split it into smaller refunds or work around that limit.

What I've done is escalate the full order to a specialist (reference ESC-700). They'll follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, but the case is documented as an entire order that never arrived.

If it helps, you could place a new order now for the group. I know that's not what you want to hear, and I'm sorry I can't do more on the refund right now.

Okay. I pushed once and I get it, so I'll accept the escalation. But 24 hours doesn't help me today, so please make sure they have my number, +1 415-555-0133, and the order number 5105. Also, the Visa I paid with is the card on file, so they'll be able to see the charge.

Thanks for at least getting it on record. I'm going to try to find something to feed these people before they revolt.

Thanks for understanding, Lucia. Your phone number, +1 415-555-0133, is on your account. The escalation is filed under order O-5105 and notes that you paid with the Visa ending in 4242. The specialist will have both.

I can't add anything to the existing escalation from here. Everything is on record, though, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

I hope you find something to feed everyone soon. I'm sorry about today.
